note: Set A correctly identifies the high thickness values (~80-100mm) associated with the CarbonUD layers at the Suction and Pressure sides, matching the visual bar heights in the charts. Set B frequently misreads these magnitudes, claiming total thicknesses of 30-40mm at the Suction Side where the charts show ~90mm, and incorrectly places the thick CarbonUD layer at the Leading Edge (LE) where the bars are visually short. Set B also mislocates the medium_density_foam thickness to the Trailing Edge (TE) in several claims, contradicting the chart layout where foam is central.
